item.title: Trump and Carney hold urgent talks as steep 50% US tariffs on Canada loom
item.description: Canada’s Prime Minister Mark Carney has held urgent talks with US President Donald Trump, Ottawa confirmed Tuesday, in an effort to avoid fresh US tariffs on Canadian goods as a midnight deadline fast approaches. Trump signed orders for the steep 50 per cent duties last month, with the White House alleging “discriminatory treatment” by Canada against US alcohol, car and dairy products. The tariffs are set to take effect on Wednesday, covering products such as wine, hockey sticks and cement.... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Balance en Colombia: De la Espriella anticipa una reconstrucción “dura”; Petro cuestiona al Gobierno
item.description: Una semana después del terremoto de magnitud 7,4 que sacudió el occidente de Colombia, el presidente Abelardo De La Espriella presentó su primer gran balance de la emergencia y situó en cerca de 30 billones de pesos — más de 9.500 millones de dólares— las pérdidas físicas preliminares en cinco departamentos, al tiempo que anunció un plan de reconstrucción, ayudas para las familias damnificadas y medidas especiales para el Chocó. La oposición, encabezada por el exmandatario Gustavo Petro, cuestionó la gestión del Gobierno y anunció que solicitará una réplica a la alocución del jefe de Estado. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Pakistan top court orders ex-PM Imran Khan be moved to hospital from jail
item.description: Pakistan’s Supreme Court ordered on Tuesday that jailed former prime minister Imran Khan be moved to hospital for medical checks, after a petition by his lawyers over claims of poor health. Justice Shahid Waheed said 73-year-old Khan, who had been in jail since 2023 on corruption charges, would be shifted in the next two days to Shifa International Hospital in the capital Islamabad.
